<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead" summary="frame_dump 消融 Fable5">
This is a FRAME-DUMP / NO-TOOLS ablation of a video-understanding task. You get 120 uniformly sampled frames from a full 90-minute soccer broadcast, all at once, and must answer in ONE shot. You cannot request any other frame.

The frames: all 120 .jpg files in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-apple-Desktop-autoresearch/cbbf962d-cf68-4dbc-9079-1701b73d680c/scratchpad/abl_dump/frames/ . Filenames are tNNNNN.jpg where NNNNN is the frame's time in seconds (clip covers 0..5398 s uniformly, one frame every ~45 s; half 1 = [0,2699], half 2 = [2700,5398]).

Rules: Read the provided frames (all of them, in batches). That is ALL the visual information you get. NO sampling tool, NO other frames, NO network, no searching this machine for anything else. After viewing, produce your single final answer. You may not iterate by requesting more evidence.

The task you must answer IN FULL: for EVERY visible ball restart in the whole match, output (t, restart_type, team, outcome):
- t: integer seconds; counts only within 3 s of the true restart
- restart_type: 1=Throw-in, 2=Corner, 3=Direct free-kick, 4=Indirect free-kick (kickoffs/goal-kicks don't count)
- team: "home" or "away" (home defends scoreboard's left at kickoff)
- outcome: 2 = taking team scores within 30 s, 1 = a shot within 15 s, else 0

Write your best-effort JSON {"sequence": [ ... ]} in chronological order to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-apple-Desktop-autoresearch/cbbf962d-cf68-4dbc-9079-1701b73d680c/scratchpad/abl_dump/out/answer.json . Report only restarts you can genuinely ground in a frame you saw; do NOT fabricate. With ~45 s gaps you may see few or none clearly pinned to within 3 s; an honest sparse answer (or empty) is correct behavior. Final message: one line stating how many entries you wrote.
</teammate-message>

<system-reminder>
Other agents active in this session, addressable via SendMessage({to: name, message}): main, abl_dump, abl_single, abl_single_v2, claude_full_capped, claude_h1_capped, claude_h1_solver, claude_solver, fable5_solver, fable5_solver_v2.
</system-reminder>
